children: Aurora Innovation, Inc. (NASDAQ: AUR) today announced it will host an Analyst & Investor Day on September 23, 2026, in Dallas. The company will share how it is scaling at a critical inflection point for the autonomous trucking industry. Keynote presentations and panels are scheduled to begin at 8:45 a.m. Central time and are expected to conclude at 11:00 a.m. Central time.
Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only. The event will be webcast on Aurora’s investor relations website at
. A replay of the webcast will be available for 30 days following the live presentations.

(Nasdaq: AUR) is delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly to make transportation safer, increasingly accessible, and more reliable and efficient than ever before.

is a self-driving system designed to operate multiple vehicle types, from freight-hauling trucks to ride-hailing passenger vehicles, and underpins Aurora's driver as a service product for trucking. Aurora is working with industry leaders across the transportation ecosystem, including AUMOVIO, FedEx, Hirschbach, McLane, NVIDIA, PACCAR, Ryder, Schneider, Toyota, Uber, Uber Freight, Volvo Trucks, Volvo Autonomous Solutions, and Werner. To learn more, visit aurora.tech.
